headline: Q2FY27 Result Update

highlights: Gross profit for the quarter reached INR 5,592 cr with a gross margin of 27.1%.
EBITDA grew to INR 2,984 cr, with consolidated EBITDA margin expanding to 14.5% (vs 12.1% in Q2FY26), while PBIT stood at INR 2,721 cr with a margin of 13.2%.
PBT surged 97.1% YoY to INR 3,001 cr (14.6% margin), supported by operating leverage and a non-operational Ind-AS credit of INR 671 cr on Damas put-option liability.
PAT and Net Profit reached INR 2,394 cr and INR 2,393 cr respectively (+113.7% YoY growth; Net profit margin of 11.6%).

watch: Operational performance across key business segments is assessed below: • Jewelry Business: Domestic jewelry revenue grew 20.8% YoY to INR 16,343 cr (Tanishq/Mia/Zoya: INR 14,935 cr, +19.9%; CaratLane: INR 1,408 cr, +31.3%).

Segment domestic EBIT reached INR 2,281 cr (14.0% margin), aided by INR 490 cr customs duty gains (INR 46 cr in CaratLane). • Watch Business: Watches revenue rose 27.4% YoY to INR 1,881 cr (domestic: INR 1,838 cr, +27.2%), led by analog premiumisation in Helios and Vetra automatic movement.
